newsitem.title: FRANCE: French FO union joins Oct 17 rail strike call.
newsitem.headline: French FO union joins Oct 17 rail strike call.

text.p: French labour union Force Ouvriere said on Friday it was joining the call by several other unions for a one-day strike at the SNCF state railway on October 17, the same day as a one-day strike by civil service employees.

The FO union said in a statement it took the decision after a meeting with the CGT, CFDT and FMC unions and that the four wanted to protest in defence of jobs, the public service a pay and pensions increase.
They also wanted to protest against an EU "white paper" on liberalising European Union rail services, the statement said.
A rail strike on October 17 had already been called by the Communist-led CGT and the pro-Socialist CFDT.

A civil service strike has been called for the same day to protest against planned job cuts as part of the 1997 budget. Unions at the French gas and electricity utilities GDF and EDF have announced they too will take part.
